key_decisions.rationale: Preserves commodity, exact amounts, document, and urgency.
key_decisions.before: The man said, ‘A hundred measures of olive oil.’ The steward told him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and write fifty.’
key_decisions.after: He answered, ‘A hundred measures of olive oil.’ The manager told him, ‘Take your bill, sit down quickly, and write fifty.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said, ‘A hundred measures of oil.’ And he said to him, ‘Take your bill and, sitting down quickly, write fifty.’

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps second commodity and distinct reduction.
key_decisions.before: Then he asked another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ The man said, ‘A hundred measures of wheat.’ He told him, ‘Take your bill and write eighty.’
key_decisions.after: Then he asked another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ He replied, ‘A hundred measures of wheat.’ The manager told him, ‘Take your bill and write eighty.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then he said to another, ‘And you, how much do you owe?’ And he said, ‘A hundred measures of wheat.’ He says to him, ‘Take your bill and write eighty.’

key_decisions.rationale: Retains praise for shrewdness without approving dishonesty and preserves two groups.
key_decisions.before: The master commended the unrighteous steward because he had acted shrewdly. For the children of this age are more shrewd toward their own generation than the children of light.
key_decisions.after: The master praised the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the children of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own generation than the children of light are.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And the master commended the unrighteous steward because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd toward their own generation than the sons of light.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps difficult wealth phrase, failure, friendship, and eternal tents.
key_decisions.before: And I tell you, make friends for yourselves by means of unrighteous wealth so that when it fails, they may welcome you into eternal dwellings.
key_decisions.after: And I tell you, make friends for yourselves by means of dishonest wealth, so that when it fails they may welcome you into eternal dwellings.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And I say to you, make friends for yourselves from the wealth of unrighteousness, so that when it fails, they may receive you into the eternal dwellings.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps household setting, paired alternatives, and exclusive service.
key_decisions.before: No servant can serve two masters. Either they will hate one and love the other, or be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.”
key_decisions.after: No household servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate one and love the other, or he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: No servant is able to serve two masters; for either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will hold to one and despise the other. You are not able to serve God and wealth.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps public self-justification, divine heart knowledge, and value reversal.
key_decisions.before: He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves before people, but God knows your hearts. What is highly valued among people is detestable before God.
key_decisions.after: He said to them, “You are the ones who justify yourselves before people, but God knows your hearts. What people highly esteem is detestable before God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves before people, but God knows your hearts; for what is exalted among people is an abomination before God.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves temporal hinge and the difficult forceful-entry language without overexplaining it.
key_decisions.before: The Law and the Prophets were until John. Since then God’s kingdom is announced as good news, and everyone is pressing into it.
key_decisions.after: The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since then the good news of God’s kingdom is announced, and everyone presses forcefully into it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The Law and the Prophets were until John; from then on the kingdom of God is proclaimed as good news, and everyone is pressing into it.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps cosmic comparison and tiny written mark.
key_decisions.before: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one stroke of a letter of the Law to fall.
key_decisions.after: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one stroke of a letter in the Law to fall.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one stroke of a letter of the Law to fall.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains gender-specific relationships and repeated adultery claim.
key_decisions.before: Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery, and whoever marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery.
key_decisions.after: Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and a man who marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery, and the one who marries a woman divorced from a husband commits adultery.

key_decisions.after: A poor man named Lazarus, covered with sores, had been laid at his gate.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And a certain poor man named Lazarus had been laid at his gate, covered with sores,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps hunger, table scraps, dogs, and bodily humiliation.
key_decisions.before: He longed to be fed with what fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.
key_decisions.after: He longed to be filled with what fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and desiring to be fed from what was falling from the table of the rich man; but even the dogs were coming and licking his sores.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves contrasting deaths, angels, Abraham, and burial.
key_decisions.before: The poor man died and was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried.
key_decisions.after: The poor man died and was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And it happened that the poor man died and was carried away by the angels into Abraham’s bosom; and the rich man also died and was buried.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Hades, torment, distance, and reversed proximity.
key_decisions.before: In Hades, while in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus at his side.
key_decisions.after: In Hades, where he was in torment, the rich man looked up and saw Abraham far away with Lazarus at his side.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And in Hades, lifting up his eyes, being in torment, he sees Abraham from afar and Lazarus in his bosom.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves kinship claim, request using Lazarus as servant, tiny water amount, and suffering.
key_decisions.before: He called out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me! Send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in anguish in this flame.’
key_decisions.after: He called out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me! Send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this flame.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And calling out, he said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus so that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in anguish in this flame.’

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps tender address, remembered reversal, and contrasting present conditions.

key_decisions.after: But Abraham said, ‘Child, remember that during your life you received your good things, while Lazarus likewise received bad things. But now he is comforted here, and you are in agony.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves fixed barrier, desire, and two-way impossibility.

key_decisions.after: Besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and you, so that those who want to cross from here to you cannot, nor can anyone cross from there to us.’
